Published PC image evidence for [[Haven (PC 2024 D-E1 card)]], [[Haven (PC 2024 D-E1 card)|Haven (PC Errata 2)]] and [[Haven (PC 2024 D-E1 card)|Haven (PC Errata 3)]]. Lossless PNG of the actual composed page rectangle [35.99399948120117, 303.4440002441406, 214.86599731445312, 387.2760009765625] on original page 22 of [[:File:PC-Decipher-Errata-June-2017.pdf]], official text as of1June2017. Actual vector/text overlays are included. Render scale745/rectangle-width; full content retained. The first publication day remains unknown.

Card design and artwork copyright as printed on the official source; original Decipher design, PC errata rendition. Used to identify and study the published card versions on this non-commercial fan wiki.
